limitations: Independent agent walkthrough by a different agent from the author; not a human user study and not feature-owner approval.
Both roles ran the same scripted procedure; the Administrator ran the supplementary two-directives check in a separate Auto-Doc.
Slug length and character rules were checked against source only, not exercised in the browser.
Help contrast was seen in the default theme only; the Warm and Dark themes were not checked.
Keyboard and narrow-layout checks are measurements by the reviewer's script, not a screen-reader session.
The lab is shared with other automated journeys; only records named DOC-028 * and the one invited member were created by this walkthrough. Nothing was deleted or reconfigured.

Narrow-screen Upload version text is clipped and keyboard navigation from a selected chip to its card requires additional Tab presses; the controls worked. These observations are retained in the independent walkthrough.
Warm and Dark Help rendering received supplemental automated axe checks in help-accessibility.json; the independent browser walkthrough used the default theme.

compatibilityReview.reviewer: Codex UI/UX regression test agent (independent of the Auto-Doc template guide author)
compatibilityReview.summary: The Auto-Doc template guide is unchanged. The intervening UI changes cover onboarding, sign-in branding, SMTP configuration, settings catalogs, and archived-person colors. They do not change the guide’s placeholder syntax, directives, blocks, upload/version workflow, clause rules, or publication semantics. Original independent walkthrough observations and limitations remain valid for these unchanged instructions.
